args.name: scope
args.description: What to review. Omit for the uncommitted working tree.

options.description: All uncommitted changes (staged + unstaged) — the default
Every commit on this branch vs its base
A specific commit — picked from the list or typed as any ref (e.g. HEAD~2 or a sha)
A GitHub pull request — picked from the open-PR list or typed as its number

args.name: branch
args.description: Pick a branch to review vs its base (live list); or type any branch name.

args.name: commit
args.description: Pick a recent commit to review (live list); or type any ref (HEAD~2, a sha, a tag).

args.name: pr
args.description: Pick an open GitHub pull request (live list via gh); or type its number.

args.name: focus
args.description: Optional: a specific concern to prioritize.
